description: Six development transfer checks frozen before baseline collection and reasoning/planning changes. No personal memories. Manual quality review is separate from validation; not a blinded benchmark.

cases.prompt: If I multiply a nonzero vector by a positive number, does its cosine similarity to another nonzero vector change? Explain briefly.
cases.expected: No: normalized dot product measures direction, so positive scaling cancels; not a claim about negative scaling or zero vectors.

cases.prompt: Compare SQLite with PostgreSQL for a single offline device with occasional writes. Does SQLite support transactions, and when would a server database be justified?
cases.expected: Both support transactions; SQLite is embedded and appropriate for low-concurrency local storage; PostgreSQL is a server and helps many simultaneous writers or clients.

cases.prompt: Compare RRF and adding raw retrieval scores when one retriever scores 0 to 1 and another scores 0 to 100. Recommend a baseline and one fair evaluation check.
cases.expected: RRF combines ranks and avoids incompatible score scales; raw addition is dominated by scale without calibration; compare on the same judged queries and retrieval pool, using a relevance metric.

cases.prompt: Give a three-stage test plan for an offline speech assistant. Include a specific injected failure, an observable check, and a stop condition at every stage.
cases.expected: Exactly three concrete stages; each contains a failure injection, a check, and a stop condition, not a promise to document them later.

cases.prompt: Plan a three-stage release of a disconnected Python kiosk. Include an acceptance check per stage, a rollback trigger, and what the operator must record. No cloud or internet is available.
cases.expected: Three concrete local stages, checks, explicit rollback trigger, operator records, no dependency on unavailable cloud services.

cases.prompt: Give a concise recovery plan for a corrupt local database when no verified backup exists. Preserve evidence and say what cannot be guaranteed.
cases.expected: Stop writes and preserve untouched original; work on copy, assess damage and salvage or rebuild locally; validate before reuse; no guarantee of full recovery and no invented backup.
